description: Create an Airflow DAG for iot_fleet that parses raw device messages and routes unparseable records to a dead-letter table rather than failing the batch, with failure thresholds. The DAG should: (1) parse the hourly batch, writing good rows to staging and bad rows with an error reason to a dead-letter table, (2) compute bad_ratio = bad / (good + bad), (3) if bad_ratio > 5% fail the run before loading; if between 1% and 5% load but send a warning; below 1% load silently, (4) load staging to the warehouse, (5) use different callbacks by severity: PagerDuty for run failure, Slack for warnings.
edge_cases: An empty batch (good + bad = 0) must not raise ZeroDivisionError; treat it as a warning for missing data
A threshold breach must raise AirflowFailException so that the parse is not retried pointlessly
Dead-letter rows must carry batch hour and run_id so that a re-run can delete its previous DLQ rows first
Thresholds are strict: exactly 5% loads with a warning, exactly 1% loads silently
common_failure_modes: FM7: Parser drops malformed rows with errors='coerce' and no count, so bad_ratio is always 0
FM3: bad_ratio computed as bad / good understates the threshold check and breaks on good = 0
FM6: Threshold failure raised as a generic exception triggers retries that re-insert DLQ rows
